use_cases: Landing page hero sections with smooth scrolling transitions between content blocks
Storytelling-style page layouts with scroll-triggered section reveals
Portfolio or marketing pages requiring immersive scroll experiences
Product pages with alternating dark and light section transitions
Single-page applications needing fluid navigation between sections
ai_summary: A smooth scroll page layout component using ReactLenis for fluid scrolling behavior. Features multiple sticky-positioned sections with alternating dark and light themes, creating a reveal-on-scroll effect. Includes a grid pattern background with radial mask for visual depth. Designed for landing pages and storytelling-style content layouts.
